releaseNotes: Cloudflare tunnel works on networks that block trycloudflare.com: when the direct sign-up is blocked the station signs up for its quick tunnel through a PrintAway relay on Vercel, then runs over Cloudflare's normal edge. The watchdog reads cloudflared's own health status instead of opening the public link from the shop PC, so a busy or locally-blocked tunnel is no longer replaced (which changed the customer link). localhost.run is only a backup; the station returns to Cloudflare within 15 minutes. Pinggy tunnel removed. Includes 2.6.2: FormData uploads, parallel tunnel discovery and the Supabase Cloud Relay.
